metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the porch at St Helen's, the four-voice memo, the cut list, and one line in the almanac.

yesterday: Mistress Ansell said your name twice before you heard her. You told her you were only a poet.
Sir John Spencer went out alone. He did not look at you, and he did not speak.
The list that survived names Saturday's lovers, Thursday's copy, the three court nights, Tilney on the 16th, and the carrier. The second half is struck.
The almanac says Richmond, twenty-six days off. The six lines and the letter of the 16th stand, and you paid nothing.
